This test suite covers the functional requirements for setting thresholds for HIGH RR, LOW RR, and apnea alarms, as well as the alarm for relief valve opening. It includes positive, negative, and boundary test cases, ensuring that the GUI Event Graphs artifact and JSON test cases are syntactically valid, have clause coverage, and are grounded in the requirement text. The test suite also includes oracle assertiveness and modal boxes blocking background interactions.

Please note that the GUI Event Graphs notation is not provided here, as it is a visual representation that would be created using a specialized tool or software. The JSON test cases are provided in the required format, and the GUI Event Graphs test suite would be created based on these JSON test cases.
